title: I ran out of tokens, so I'm challenging Reddit to vibe-code Streets of Rage with GPT-6 Astra 😂
author: Claude_co
selftext:
🎮 I have a challenge for the vibe coding community: Rebuild Streets of Rage with GPT-6 Astra

Remember Streets of Rage on the Sega Genesis?

The side-scrolling beat ’em up.

The streets.

The ridiculous amount of punching random guys.

That legendary 90s soundtrack. 😂

Well...

I want to see what happens if someone gives this idea to GPT-6 Astra.

Not a game inspired by it.

I mean: take the core experience and try to recreate that old-school feeling with modern AI-assisted game development.

🕹️ Side-scrolling combat

🥊 Beat ’em up mechanics

👊 Combos

💥 Enemies + bosses

🎵 Retro atmosphere

🏙️ Streets / levels

🎮 Local co-op if you can pull it off

✨ But built from scratch with modern tools

And here's the funny part:

I would do it myself...

but unfortunately...

💀 I ran out of tokens.

My wallet has left the chat.

My API credits are fighting for their lives.

So I'm officially outsourcing this to Reddit. 😂

🚨 THE CHALLENGE

If you're a vibe coder, game dev, AI tinkerer, or just someone with way too many tokens:

Build it.

Use GPT-6 Astra, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Codex, whatever you want.

Godot, Unity, Phaser, web tech, whatever.

I don't care.

Just make a playable prototype.

Even if it's ugly.

Even if the main character looks like a potato.

Even if the first enemy is literally a rectangle with anger issues.

I just want to see how far we can push this.

Who's crazy enough to try it? 👀

Drop your prototype / GitHub / video in the comments.

I'll be watching. 🍿

And if someone actually manages to make a surprisingly good version...

I'll happily admit that I started this challenge because I was too broke to pay for the tokens. 😂

Obviously, don't use Sega's copyrighted assets or ship a commercial clone. This is just a fun technical challenge to see what modern AI-assisted development can actually do.
